_comment: The production image of this repository and what it is made of (atrium-project#72 A.3).
Checked on every push by the hub's workflow-lint.reusable.yml (tools/ci/image_closure.py):
every first-party file the entrypoint can execute must be listed here or be a hub-canonical
shared component (docs/templates/shared/MANIFEST.json); a listed file it no longer reaches
fails too. Run it locally with: python ../atrium-project/tools/ci/image_closure.py
Today's `-api` is the keyword stage's controlled half (the LLM over the AMCR and TEATER
vocabularies). The whole target leaves with its code for atrium-keyword-extractor
(atrium-nlp-enrich#40, atrium-llm-enrich#29); this repository's production image becomes
targets of the keyword stage and `digital` the converter's CLI: published, never pinned.
The api_util/*_md.py, doc_to_visual_md.py and digital_*.py files are the record -> Markdown
renderer and the converter it reads PDFs and DOCX with: the converter owns them, and
keyword-extractor will vendor the renderer with SHA pins (#72 B). teitok_read.py and
bbox_scale.py are nlp-enrich's, pinned by tests/test_vendored_teitok_parity.py.
